d:
Jeremy Wade dives into the ocean’s most intriguing mysteries, exploring hidden wrecks, investigating unusual underwater discoveries and following clues to stories lost beneath the waves. From forgotten history to strange finds on the ocean floor, every investigation reveals how much remains unknown about the deep sea. What could these discoveries tell us about the secrets still waiting to be uncovered?
Watch Mysteries of the Deep, Season 1, Episodes 1, 10, 4, 7, 9, 8 and 2, on Discovery Channel India.
